svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut one piece 700 x 450 mm from 4 mm hardboard; sand the edges and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Prime, then paint the smooth face matte light grey (two coats).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rule a 50 mm grid in mid grey from the two centre lines: 13 lines

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: across (the last 50 mm from each end), 9 lines deep (25 from the edges).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lines about 1 mm wide (a fine paint marker along a steel rule).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the centre of the long back edge with a short line on the edge:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: it lines up with the base board's centre mark.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seal with clear matte varnish so it wipes clean; no gloss (glare).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: lies flat on the bench, back edge against the base board's

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front edge, centre marks lined up. Nothing fixes it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: flat on the bench; no shine under a lamp from the phone's view.
